h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kota

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kota

items.pText: Kota is known across India for its coaching institutes, but it is also a city of families, schools and new residential colonies along the Chambal. Summers here are long and fierce, and that heat shapes how a playground should be planned. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 710 km from Kota, and sends it by road to sites across Rajasthan.

We work with schools, housing societies, builders and public gardens. You share the site size, the age group and photos, and we suggest equipment and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing. When you approve the layout and quote, we build the equipment, dispatch it and install it through our own team or a dealer in north India.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: From April to June, slides and decks in full sun get too hot for children to use in the afternoon. Orientation helps more than anything else. Where possible, set slides so the sliding surface faces north or sits in the shadow of a building or tree, and plan a shade structure over toddler pieces.

Roto-moulded plastic stays cooler to the touch than bare metal, and lighter shades from our 15+ colour options absorb less heat than dark ones. Rubber flooring is better than paver blocks, which hold heat and are hard to fall on. Our

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment in Kota?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture in Vasai, send the equipment to Kota by road and install it with our team or a dealer in north India, either grouted or on a self-standing base.

items.q: Which colours stay cooler in a Rajasthan summer?
items.a: Lighter shades absorb less heat than dark ones. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colours, so you can pick light tones for slides and decks that face the sun.

items.q: Can children use the playground in the afternoon in May?
items.a: Only if it is shaded. Plan the layout so slides face away from the afternoon sun and add shade over younger children's pieces, or schedule outdoor play for the morning and evening.
